The Department of Computer and Data Sciences in the Case School of Engineering at Case Western Reserve University (CWRU) invites applications for a non-tenure track faculty position.

The search prioritizes candidates at the Assistant or Associate Professor rank with a strong interest in teaching and student advising.

The Department of Computer and Data Sciences was formed with the vision that computing and data sciences will play a central role in interdisciplinary research and education throughout the university.

If you would like to talk about the position and are at SIGCSE TS this year, several members of the department are here and would be happy to discuss!

For more information and to submit an application, please visit
CWRU provides reasonable accommodations to applicants with disabilities. Applicants requiring a reasonable accommodation for any part of the application and hiring process should call 216-368-3066.
